assumptions: Cognitive architectures possess modular or inspectable control structures.
Metareasoning mechanisms can evaluate intermediate logical steps independently of primary generation pipelines.
definition.falsification: Empirically observed error rates remain indistinguishable between architectures with and without explicit metareasoning loops under controlled problem sets.
definition.statement: Cognitive architectures incorporating explicit metareasoning feedback loops can systematically identify and mitigate blind spots that simpler feedforward operational constraints fail to detect.
definition.uncertainty: The extent to which architectural self-monitoring can uncover novel logical flaws versus pre-programmed error patterns.

convergence_evidence.remaining_uncertainty: The extent to which architectural self-monitoring can uncover novel logical flaws versus pre-programmed error patterns.
convergence_evidence.decision_rule: Compare the feasible next distinguishing test, expected uncertainty reduction and cost against the frozen stop rule. Budget exhaustion or administrative closure is not scientific resolution.

limits: Finite computational evidence does not establish a general theorem or natural-science discovery.
Closing an investigation is an administrative stop; its recorded scientific uncertainty remains.
Execution validity, measurement validity, model interpretation and replication are separate fields.
Token and monetary costs are unavailable unless a provider reports them; they are never inferred as zero.
